package.description: Cross-platform key-remapping daemon and cli utility.

en-US.description: Cross-platform key-remapping daemon and cli utility.
en-US.longDescription:
keymapper is a cross-platform key-remapping daemon and cli utility for
macOS, Linux, and Windows.  It captures keyboard events with a low-level
hook, applies user-defined remapping rules (optionally scoped to specific
applications or keyboards), and emits the mapped keys.
en-US.name: keymapper
